map.完整度评分按期望项目覆盖率计算（4S 店记录权重 1.0、汽修厂 0.85），全: Completeness score is by expected-item coverage (4S-store weight 1.0, repair shop 0.85); full coverage and standard records give score>90, grade "excellent". Residual value-add ratio taken as +12.5%: if vehicle valuation is 100k CNY, the maintenance bonus ≈ +12.5k CNY, adjusted residual ≈ 112.5k. If only half the items are covered, score falls in 50~70, only +2.5% (+2.5k).
map.完整度评分怎么影响残值？: How does the completeness score affect residual value?
map.评分>90→残值+12.5%、≥70→+7.5%、≥50→+2.5%、否则-5%: Score>90 → residual +12.5%, ≥70 → +7.5%, ≥50 → +2.5%, otherwise -5%. 4S-store records weigh higher than ordinary repair shops (1.0 vs 0.85); continuous, on-time records within the maintained mileage add more. This ratio is only empirical; actual premium also depends on brand and condition.
map.可补录已知保养（注明来源），缺失项会拉低覆盖分；建议尽量补全 4S 电子记录或发: You can back-fill known maintenance (noting the source); missing items lower the coverage score; it is advised to complete 4S electronic records or invoices as much as possible. The tool supports entering multiple records and judging "done or not" by current mileage; items not yet due are not counted as missing.
